spoken_summary: An unseen speaker details Christopher Columbus's history and his importance to Italian-Americans. Donald Trump then interjects, "In other words, we're calling it Columbus Day." After applause, Trump jokes that "the press" was the source of the applause. He holds up the signed document and says, "Columbus Day. We're back. Columbus Day, we're back, Italians."

central_claim: Donald Trump has officially reinstated the celebration of Columbus Day.
